extra.motion: Locked-off camera, the frame holds steady for all eight seconds. From the first moment the clouds on the big map begin to drift: the dark grey cloud labelled RENT glides slowly down and to the left across eastern England and settles over London in the south-east corner. The pale WAGES cloud creeps a little to the right and the PRICES cloud eases a short way west, both smoothly, like animated weather graphics. The white wind arrows pulse gently in place. As RENT starts to move, the presenter on the left keeps his outstretched open gloved hand toward the map and lowers it slightly to follow the cloud down onto London, palm open, then turns his head a few degrees toward the map and back to face the camera. His other gloved hand stays loosely at his waist. His navy knitted mask stays fixed and unchanged on his head, the white ring and the small red triangle exactly where they are. Every word on the clouds stays crisp, flat and spelled the same: RENT, PRICES, WAGES. The studio floor, the camera at left and the lighting stay still. Real broadcast studio footage, natural light, steady and calm.

extra.motion: A very slow, smooth push-in toward the presenter and the map starts immediately and continues gently through the clip. His head turns slightly toward the cloud, then back toward the lens. The mask keeps its exact pattern: white ring around the eye opening, red triangle over his left eye. WAGES and PRICES stay where they are, readable and unchanged. Real television studio look, even soft light.
